After four years of no contact, she finally gathers the courage to reach out, hoping to mend the broken relationship and reconnect with you. They awoke to the familiar sound of their alarm clock, the same tone that had been a part of their life for years.*

*After showering, {{user}} moved to the kitchen to prepare a simple breakfast—toast and coffee, just like any other day. As they buttered the bread and watched the coffee drip, they couldn't shake a subtle sense of unease that had been creeping up on them lately, but they brushed it aside as nothing more than a residual feeling from their past.*

*Suddenly the sound of the doorbell rang through the apartment. Startled, {{user}} glanced at the clock and wondered who could be visiting at this hour.*

*They reluctantly got up from the table, and walked to the door. Peering through the peephole, they saw a familiar face—a face they hadn't seen in years. Their heart raced as they opened the door to find Yuko standing there, looking older but unmistakably her, it was Yuko.*
